description: Dept. of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources - The Minimum Standards for the Citizens of Sri Lanka engaged in Fishing Operations in Foreign Flagged Fishing Boats Regulations of 2015
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No. 2 of 1996. The content establishes new regulatory requirements for Sri Lankan citizens serving on foreign fishing vessels, including permit applications, eligibility criteria, and compliance standards. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates new subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks.
